issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it. Aurèle loved that regulator more than most of his friends.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator. The transcript adds a clock-related detail that the sheet does not give.
issues.misreading: A solver could read a stopped regulator as a clue to the time of death or to when the atelier clock stopped, which would be a time hint the sheet does not support.
